name: find_airports
description: Search for airports by name, IATA code, ICAO code, country, or proximity to geographic coordinates. Returns matching airports with coordinates, codes, and location details.

lang.description: Preferred language code for localized airport and place names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to 90) for proximity-based ranking

limit.description: Maximum number of airports to return (default: 10, min: 1, max: 25)

lng.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to 180) for proximity-based ranking

name: find_nearby
description: Find points of interest (POIs) and destinations near coordinates within a specified radius (meters).

lang.description: Optional language code for place names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

min_stars.description: Minimum star rating for accommodation (1 to 5)

radius_meters.description: Search radius in meters (1 to 50000, default: 5000)

places.description: List of nearby places sorted by distance

name: geocode
description: Forward geocoding: resolve place names, addresses, or landmarks into coordinates and candidate places.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to restrict results (e.g. 'BE', 'FR')

lang.description: Optional preferred language code for place names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

lat.description: Optional latitude for proximity-biased results (-90 to 90)

limit.description: Maximum candidate places to return (default: 10, max: 10)

lng.description: Optional longitude for proximity-biased results (-180 to 180)

query.description: Search query or place name to geocode (e.g. 'Atomium', 'Brussels', 'Grand Place')

places.description: List of candidate places with coordinates and details

name: get_airport
description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific airport by its 3-letter IATA code (e.g. 'BRU', 'JFK') or 4-letter ICAO code (e.g. 'EBBR', 'KJFK').

lang.description: Preferred language code for localized airport name (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

name: get_place
description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a single place by its Geomilli ID or Wikidata QID.

include_nearby.description: Whether to include nearby points of interest

lang.description: Optional language code for localized place names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

verbose.description: If true, returns full entity with all aliases, localized names, and metadata; if false, returns token-efficient compact place

nearby_places.description: Nearby places if include_nearby was requested

place.description: Place details (compact view when verbose=false; includes all alternate names, languages, and source when verbose=true)

name: get_service_status
description: Retrieve consolidated operational health, harvester ingestion daemon status, and API telemetry metrics for the Geomilli cluster.

health.description: API service and search engine health probe

error.description: Error message if the health probe failed

status.description: API health status: ok, degraded, down, or unreachable

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the health check probe

active_job.description: Currently active country ingestion job, if any

error.description: Error message if importer probe failed

resources.description: Harvester daemon memory and disk cache stats

state.description: Harvester daemon operational state (e.g. idle, running, stopped, unreachable)

metrics.description: API telemetry and indexing performance metrics

error.description: Error message if metrics probe failed

index_docs.description: Total indexed place documents in Meilisearch

total_requests.description: Total HTTP requests handled since startup

overall_status.description: Synthesized health status: ok, degraded, or unhealthy

name: list_cities
description: List major cities and towns for a specific country by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, ordered by population and popularity score.

lang.description: Preferred language code for localized city names

limit.description: Maximum number of cities to return (default: 20, min: 1, max: 100)

cities.description: List of cities with coordinates and population

name: list_countries
description: List all countries currently indexed in the Geomilli database along with total place counts. Use this to determine which countries have available geospatial data.

countries.description: Indexed countries sorted by place count descending

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. BE, FR)

country_name.description: Official or common name of the country

place_count.description: Number of indexed places and destinations

name: list_import_queue
description: List the Harvester ingestion daemon queue, active worker slots, and pending country import tasks.

concurrency.description: Max concurrent country import workers configured

country_locks.description: Active country locks held by workers

queued_tasks.description: Queued country import tasks waiting for execution

name: list_importable_countries
description: List all countries available for OSM data download and ingestion by the Harvester daemon, including indexing status and sync schedules.

continent.description: Optional filter: continent name to filter by (e.g. 'europe', 'north-america', 'asia')

only_indexed.description: Optional filter: if true, returns only countries that are already indexed in the database

countries.description: List of countries with ingestion metadata and sync schedules

name: list_place_categories
description: List the 19 canonical place categories and their taxonomy definitions, including layer (poi/admin), base ranking score, and known subclasses. Call this tool to discover valid category and class filters for search and discovery.

base_score.description: Base ranking score for the class

subclasses.description: List of known subclasses for this class

name: list_regions
description: List administrative regions, provinces, or states for a specific country by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'BE', 'FR', 'DE').

lang.description: Preferred language code for localized region names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

regions.description: List of administrative regions and provinces

total_hits.description: Total count of administrative regions/provinces found

name: measure_distance
description: Calculate the great-circle distance between two geographic locations using the Haversine formula. Coordinates can be provided directly (lat/lng) or resolved automatically from Geomilli place IDs.

from_place_id.description: Starting place ID (resolved via API if coordinates omitted)

to_place_id.description: Destination place ID (resolved via API if coordinates omitted)

distance_km.description: Great-circle distance in kilometers (rounded to 2 decimals)

distance_meters.description: Great-circle distance in meters (rounded to 1 decimal)

distance_miles.description: Great-circle distance in miles (rounded to 2 decimals)

name: places_in_area
description: Find places and destinations within a geographic bounding box defined by minimum and maximum latitude and longitude coordinates.

lang.description: Optional language code for place names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

total_hits.description: Total matching places found in bounding box

name: reverse_geocode
description: Reverse geocoding: resolve latitude and longitude coordinates into a structured address, administrative hierarchy, and closest place.

lang.description: Optional language code for place names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

radius_meters.description: Search radius in meters (1 to 100000, default: 50000)

admin_hierarchy.description: Administrative hierarchy from city to country

closest_place.description: Closest place to the given coordinates

name: search_places
description: Search places, destinations, and points of interest using full-text search and structured filters (class, subclass, country, cuisine, star rating).

lang.description: Preferred language code for place names (e.g. 'en', 'fr')

query.description: Full-text search keywords or place name

star_rating.description: Filter by minimum star rating for hotels (1 to 5)
